name: thevemana
description: Claude Code plugins by Vemana Madasu, aimed at people who are still learning the tool.

plugins.name: handrail
plugins.description: Something to hold onto while you learn Claude Code: seven skills that write and refine your global CLAUDE.md, capture new rules the moment they come up, give a project a memory across sessions, and get independent takes on a draft or a verdict before it ships, and two opt-in hooks that enforce what a markdown file can only ask for.
